regime: CIRO Proficiency Model for Approved Persons of Investment Dealers (IDPC Rules)
replaces: Pre-2026 CSI course-based proficiency pathway for retail Registered Representatives (CSI exclusive arrangement ended 2025-12-31; Rule 2629(1) transition carve-out for CSI courses completed and applied for before 2027-01-01). Rule 2629(2): an individual required to complete Wealth Management Essentials (WME) as of 2025-12-31 may complete the Retail Securities Exam instead.

format.item_set_note: Syllabus states only 'Multiple choice' (no standard/item-set split, unlike the Supervisor Exam); the official practice exam has no shared-scenario blocks. Treated as 120 standalone questions — inference from official materials, no explicit official statement.
format.options_note: 4 options (A–D) per the official practice exam; the syllabus does not state the option count.
format.scratch_paper: not permitted; remote exams use in-platform scratch pad
format.calculator_policy: Personal calculators not permitted under any circumstances; an on-screen Prometric calculator (Basic and Scientific modes) is provided — not a financial/TVM calculator (Fitch Learning Support, updated 2026-10-17; applies to all CIRO exams). The article describes the ProProctor (remote) calculator; the test-centre interface is not separately described.
format.calculations: Substantial: bond price/yield, modified duration, time value of money, financial ratios, fund valuation, CAPM, income tax and capital gains, performance measurement (syllabus element summaries/outcomes). Must be solvable with a basic/scientific calculator.
format.taxonomy_note: Levels are cumulative: an Apply-level outcome may also be tested at Understand and Remember levels. Apply explicitly includes 'calculate'.

scoring.pass_mark_note: Not published. Each exam form has its own psychometrically set passing standard; candidates receive pass/fail only, immediately, with portal confirmation within 24h. Absent = fail.

fees_cad.payment: credit card only via Fitch Learning enrolment portal (dealers with Firm Portal access may pay for candidates)

attempts.cooling_off: 6 months after 3 failed/absent attempts within 6 months

administration.support_phone: 1 (647) 905-5108 (9am-6pm ET, Mon-Fri, excl. Canadian national and Ontario provincial holidays)

eligibility.prerequisite_exams_to_write: none (CIRE need not be passed first, though both are required for retail RR approval)
eligibility.enrolment_attestation: age of majority; work at a CIRO Dealer Member in a relevant role, OR plan to apply within 12 months, OR pursuing further CIRO exams; education providers ineligible

approval_requirements.exams: Registered Representative (retail) dealing with securities: CIRE + Retail Securities Exam (2603(1)(i)(c)); dealing with derivatives: CIRE + Retail Securities Exam + Derivatives Exam (2603(1)(i)(d)). Supervisors of retail RRs also need the RSE (2603(1)(i)(i)(I)); only their CIRE can be waived under the 2-year experience requirement.
approval_requirements.experience: relevant diploma or degree from an accredited post-secondary institution, OR minimum 4 years of relevant experience acceptable to CIRO (Rule 2603(1)(ii)(a))
approval_requirements.not_required_for: Investment Representatives (CIRE only), institutional RRs (Institutional Securities Exam), APM/PM designation holders (exempt under Rule 2627(3))
approval_requirements.mutual_funds_only_rr: Rule 2605(1): complete CIRE + Retail Securities Exam (and Conduct Training) within 270 days of approval; upgrade within 18 months of initial approval
approval_requirements.post_approval: Dealer training within 90 days of approval (Rule 2604(1)); Conduct Training within 30 days of approval, free (Rule 2604(2)); CE compliance course AND professional development course each cycle (Rule 2704)

extensions: previously approved in same category (or category requiring same exam) within 3 years
1 year of relevant securities industry experience within 3 years prior to application

official_resources.practice_exam_note: 120 questions with answer key (item ID + key letter), no rationales. CIRO describes it as an equivalent form of the exam. CIRO copyright — do not republish questions.
